about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I design products with a strong interest in mechanics, materials and manufacturing. My process is hands-on, moving between sketches, CAD, models and functional prototypes to develop simple solutions to complex problems. With a background in Interior Design and Wood Technology, I studied Industrial Design at the University of Applied Arts Vienna under Stefan Diez.
